title: A minion is building the automatic relay; one yes will be needed from you

text: A small hook will relay every prompt you give the assistant, word for word, so the assistant cannot forget, and it will remind the assistant who it is on every prompt. It will also keep one searchable file per day of everything you say in any Claude tab, outside the served site. Turning it on means one new entry in the Claude settings file. That is your config, so I will show you the exact lines and you say yes in the mastermind tab. Live speech into the log and the read aloud button come right after the dev bar chat tab lands.
